name: RDF
description: The core terms of RDF itself: rdf:type, properties, statements, lists and containers.

name: RDF Schema
description: Classes, subclasses, domains, ranges, labels and comments: the smallest vocabulary for describing vocabularies.

name: OWL
description: The Web Ontology Language: class expressions, property characteristics and equivalence, for ontologies a reasoner can use.

name: SKOS
description: Simple Knowledge Organization System: thesauri, classification schemes and subject headings as concepts with broader and narrower links.

name: PROV-O
description: Provenance: the entities, activities and agents involved in producing a piece of data.

name: DCAT
description: Data Catalog Vocabulary: datasets, their distributions and the catalogues that list them.

name: SHACL
description: Shapes Constraint Language: shapes that an RDF graph is validated against.

name: OWL-Time
description: Instants, intervals, durations and their positions on a time line.

name: DCMI Metadata Terms
description: Dublin Core: title, creator, date, subject, licence and the other everyday properties of a described resource.

name: FOAF
description: Friend of a Friend: people, organisations, their names, accounts and who knows whom.

name: Schema.org
description: A broad vocabulary for structured data on web pages, read by the major search engines.

name: GeoSPARQL
description: Spatial objects, their geometries and topological relations, with query functions for SPARQL.
